title: terminalis pumilio
intro: Terminalis pumilio, commonly known as Dwarf Terminalia, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include the ability to reduce fever, alleviate coughs, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Terminalis pumilio include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
